text: Register Using a Class Number. Go to Galaxy, click on "Orion" and log in with your NetID and password. In your UTD Student Center, select the "Manage My Classes" Tile.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number

text: Select 'Swap Classes' and then click on 'Add'.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number

text: Select the term and click 'Continue'. Enter the class number or search to find the class.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number

text: If it is a variable class, select how many semester credit hours you are taking the class for and then click on 'Next'.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number

text: Once you are done adding classes, click on 'Proceed to Step 2 of 3'.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number

text: Confirm your enrollment and click on 'Finish Enrolling'.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number

text: You should receive a green check mark in the status field and message that the class was successfully added to your schedule.
source_title: Instructions for Students to Register Using a Class Number
